text: Deepsilver is the finest metal in the world. Taking it wakes the Hollow: creatures will come up through the rock where it was mined. Mine it?
Retire {fortress}? The hall will be recorded in the Legends and cannot be resumed.
Load the quick save? Unsaved progress will be lost.
This plot has {n} growing crops. Remove it?
This stockpile holds {n} items. They will stay where they are. Remove it?
Disband {squad}? Members keep their gear.
This workshop has {n} orders. Deconstruct it?
Load the {season} snapshot? The current game continues to exist as its own saves.
Delete {save}? This cannot be undone.
Return to the main menu? Unsaved progress since {time} will be lost.
Embark without a pick?
Embark without an axe?
Embark with no food?
Embark with no drink?
Mark {what} for melting? Melted items are gone; the smelter gives back part of their metal as bars.
Mark {what} for dumping? Dwarves will carry every one of them to a dump zone.
Dump everything on these {n} tiles? Dwarves will carry it to a dump zone.
Slaughter {animal}? It will be butchered for meat, hide and bone.
Suspend {workshop}? Its current job stops and its orders wait until you resume it.
Take apart {building}? Its materials are left where it stood.
Remove {zone}? Its settings are lost.
Remove the order for {recipe}? Work in progress on it stops.
Release {creature} from {cage}? It is set down beside the cage, as wild or hostile as it was.
